1.4.0: One-click update no longer asks for a founder key — just a simple "Install v1.4 now?" Yes/No window (the server only accepts update requests coming from this computer).
Changelog is now grouped by version: the update dialog shows only what's new in the release being installed, with older releases under "Full changelog".
Fixed the update check silently reporting "you are on the latest version": the hub's release manifest is no longer mistaken for the locally installed version.
Renamed the header button to "🆕 New version?" so it can't be confused with the course-sync "🔄 Update" button.
1.3.0: Renamed the app-version check button to "🆕 App v1.3" — it was easy to confuse with the course-sync "🔄 Update" button; the tooltips now explain which is which.
The version badge at the bottom-left now shows the installed release (v1.3) and stays in sync with the app code.
1.2.0: One-click self-update: the update dialog has an "⚡ Update now" button that downloads the new app files from GitHub and installs them straight into your folder — no manual ZIP handling anymore (a backup of replaced files is kept).
The header version badge and the update checker read the installed version live from disk.
Hub-installed courses are properly marked as shared, so the admin panel can also remove them from the computer.
1.1.0: App update checker: a dialog appears when a new version is released, with the changelog and a download button.
Fixed the header "⬆ Updates" button shape.
Deleting a course in the admin panel now also removes it from the shared-hub git branch.
1.0.0: Shared hub sync via GitHub branch shared-hub.
Admin panel (Konami code) to publish/edit/delete courses in the hub.
30 exercise types: audio, video, text, speaking and more (see TEST QWEN GEN demo course).
Dark theme, search, offline file:// mode.
